heading: Police and Fire Commission Dismisses Withdrawn Complaint
category: Sun Prairie Police and Fire Commission
summary: The commission considered how to close a complaint after the complainant withdrew it. A motion to dismiss without prejudice failed. Members then approved dismissal with prejudice and directed counsel to prepare the written decision.

heading: Milwaukee Man Sentenced to 20 Years of Confinement
summary: Wisconsin DOJ said a Milwaukee man received 20 years of initial confinement and 10 years of extended supervision. He was convicted in May on 23 counts, including stalking and threats to a prosecutor. The case stemmed from conduct connected to an earlier Milwaukee County prosecution.
